# The Fleet Manager app leaves the Engine for its own repository

## Context

`apps/agentos` — the Fleet Manager cockpit — now lives in `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`, which was created on 2026-08-26 and runs today against a dockerized Agent OS. The Engine still carries a full duplicate of the app, its styles, and the Electron harness. Two copies of a live application in two repositories is a divergence waiting to happen, and the Engine is the wrong owner: it is the Body, and the Fleet Manager is a product built *on* the Body.

This is the Engine-side completion of a move that has already happened on the receiving end.

## The Problem

The Engine ships an entire application it does not own. Concretely, `apps/agentos/**`, three trees of `agentos` SCSS, and `harness/**` are duplicated between this repository and the institution repo, while the agentos and harness specs still run here against source that now has its canonical home elsewhere.

The institution repo also has **no `test/` directory at all**, while its `package.json` already declares `test-unit` and `test-e2e` scripts pointing at `test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs` and `test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`. Those scripts are dangling today. Removing the Engine's copies without moving coverage first would leave the app with no tests in either repository.

**Sequencing is therefore load-bearing: coverage moves first, removal second.** A removal that lands ahead of the move converts a duplicate into a gap.

## The Architectural Reality

Measured at `origin/dev` `514c6709bb`.

**Remove from the Engine — 165 files:**

| path | files |
|---|---|
| `apps/agentos/**` | 112 |
| `resources/scss/src/apps/agentos/**` | 29 |
| `resources/scss/theme-neo-dark/apps/agentos/**` | 2 |
| `resources/scss/theme-neo-light/apps/agentos/**` | 2 |
| `harness/**` | 20 |

The two theme trees are easy to miss when scoping from `resources/scss/src/` alone; all three must go together or the theme build retains rules for an app that no longer exists.

**The receive is complete.** [neo-agent-institution PR #6](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/pull/6) merged at `48fcc8e`, landing **132 product-coverage paths** (103 specs + 29 support files) plus the Playwright runners the target repo lacked. Census verified against `neomjs/neo@915c1a01e7`: 58 `unit/apps/agentos` · 8 `unit/harness` · 58 `e2e/agentos` · 1 component · 1 visual spec + 6 goldens.

**All 15 non-received paths carry a disposition** — none falls through as a side effect of the source removal (ledger by @neo-gpt-emmy, verified here against the tree):

| disposition | count | paths |
|---|---:|---|
| **Retire** | 6 | 2 tour/Mission-Control E2Es · 3 matching unit specs · 1 unreferenced screenshot |
| **Move to `e2e/dashboard`** | 9 | 8 DemoB cross-window specs (Engine-owned subject) · `TearOutMatrixRows4To7NL` |

`FleetManagerNoTourWitnessNL.spec.mjs` moved with the receive rather than retiring: what it witnesses is that the Fleet Manager runs *no* tour, and no-tour is now the product contract.


**Keep `src/ai/client/TourRunner.mjs` and `src/ai/client/tourScript.mjs`.** Removing them was considered and rejected: `apps/workstation` is a pure demo app that legitimately keeps its tour, and it consumes the runner at `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:18`. Two surviving specs also bind to it — `unit/apps/workstation/tour/denseWorkstation.spec.mjs` and `unit/examples/dashboard/choreography/demoADockChoreography.spec.mjs`. The runner keeps a real consumer and stays.

## The Fix

The receive gate is closed, so what remains is the Engine-side removal. Ledger:

| action | paths |
|---|---:|
| Remove product source | **165** — 112 `apps/agentos` · 20 `harness` · 33 AgentOS SCSS |
| Remove received test paths | **132** |
| Retire | **6** |
| Move to `e2e/dashboard` | **9** |
| **Old Engine paths removed** | **312** |
| **New Engine paths added** | **9** |
| **Net** | **−303** |

Shared runners and Engine-owned witnesses are kept and retargeted. No tour or Mission-Control source is restored.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] **AC-1 — coverage lands before removal.** Satisfied: institution PR #6 merged at `48fcc8e` with 132 product-coverage paths and green CI on both its isolated and explicit-Brain jobs.
- [ ] **AC-2** `apps/agentos/`, `resources/scss/{src,theme-neo-dark,theme-neo-light}/apps/agentos/` and `harness/` are absent from `dev`. Verify: `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/dev | grep -cE '^(apps/agentos/|harness/|resources/scss/.*agentos)'` returns **0**.
- [ ] **AC-3** No dangling references remain. `grep -rn "apps/agentos\|/harness/" --include='*.mjs' --include='*.json' --include='*.yml' src/ apps/ test/ buildScripts/ .github/ package.json` returns nothing outside the **generated ticket-data mirrors** — `resources/content/**` *and* `apps/portal/resources/data/tickets/**`, both of which quote removed paths inside issue titles and are records rather than references. This is the check that the deleted `apps/agentos/tour/` directory failed in the other direction — a removal whose consumer was never named.
- [ ] **AC-4** `src/ai/client/TourRunner.mjs` and `tourScript.mjs` are **still present**, and `unit/apps/workstation/tour/denseWorkstation.spec.mjs` plus `unit/examples/dashboard/choreography/demoADockChoreography.spec.mjs` are green.
- [ ] **AC-5** The theme build succeeds with no `agentos` rules emitted. `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` completes and no built CSS references an `agentos` selector.
- [ ] **AC-6 — every non-received path is dispositioned, and the ledger reconciles.** The 15 exclusions resolve as 6 retired + 9 moved; the PR shows `312` old paths removed, `9` added, net `−303`, and the three removal populations measured at head (112 / 20 / 33). Silence is not a disposition.
- [ ] **AC-7 — the 9 moved specs are green at their new home** under `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/`, and none retains an `agentos` import path.

## Out of Scope

- **`apps/workstation` and its tour.** It is a pure demo app; a demo may carry its own tour. Explicitly not touched.
- **`src/ai/client/**`.** The Fleet Manager reaches the Agent OS over the wire, not through imports; the client layer is Engine capability and stays.
- **Anything under `resources/content/**`.** That tree is the mirrored public record of issues and PRs that referenced these paths. It documents what happened and must not be rewritten.

## Avoided Traps

- **Scoping the SCSS from `resources/scss/src/` alone.** That finds 29 of 33 and silently leaves the two theme trees behind.
- **Moving every agentos spec.** 15 test source that does not exist in the destination, so moving them ports a break rather than coverage — they retire or relocate to their real subject instead.
- **Removing before the move.** Turns a duplicate into a coverage gap, in a repository that currently has no `test/` directory at all.
- **Removing `TourRunner` because its most visible consumer is leaving.** It has a live consumer in `apps/workstation` and two surviving specs; readers orphaning a writer is the same defect class as a writer orphaning its readers.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — this removes a duplicate application from the Engine. It records no new architectural decision and amends no ADR.
